box == PHASE 1 | Orchestration Startup == SCH -> ADF : Trigger pipeline\n(Scheduled: Daily 02:00 UTC) activate ADF ADF -> JC : Read job config\n(source, type, schedule, retry_policy) JC --> ADF : Return config params ADF -> BL : INSERT Batch_Log\n(Batch_ID=UUID, Status=STARTED,\nSource=, Start_Time=NOW()) ADF -> AM : Emit batch start event == PHASE 2A | Batch Ingestion — Incremental Load == ADF -> WM : READ last watermark\n(Last_Run_Timestamp for source) WM --> ADF : Return last_watermark = "2025-01-14 02:00:00" ADF -> SRC : Query source\nWHERE updated_at > last_watermark activate SRC SRC --> ADF : Return delta records (N rows) deactivate SRC ADF -> SV : Validate schema\n(Column types, nulls, mandatory fields) activate SV alt Schema valid SV --> ADF : PASS — N records valid ADF -> PL : INSERT Pipeline_Log\n(Step=SCHEMA_VALIDATE, Status=PASS, Rows=N) else Schema invalid SV --> ADF : FAIL — M records rejected ADF -> PE : INSERT Pipeline_Error\n(Batch_ID, Step=SCHEMA_VALIDATE,\nError=, Failed_Records_Sample) ADF -> PL : INSERT Pipeline_Log\n(Step=SCHEMA_VALIDATE, Status=PARTIAL) end deactivate SV ADF -> DE : Deduplicate records\n(Hash on business key) activate DE DE --> ADF : Deduped records deactivate DE ADF -> BRZ : APPEND to Raw Delta Table\n(Batch_ID, Ingestion_TS, Source_System, raw_payload) activate BRZ BRZ --> ADF : Append confirmed deactivate BRZ ADF -> BFA : Archive Parquet snapshot\n(/raw/{source}/{yyyy/mm/dd}/batch_{ID}.parquet) ADF -> WM : UPDATE watermark\n(Last_Run_Timestamp = MAX(updated_at)) ADF -> PL : INSERT Pipeline_Log\n(Step=BRONZE_LOAD, Status=SUCCESS) == PHASE 2B | Batch Ingestion — Full Load == note over ADF : Full load triggered by:\n- First-time load\n- Schema change detected\n- Manual override in Job_Config ADF -> WM : READ watermark = NULL (full load flag) ADF -> SRC : Query ALL records\n(no watermark filter) activate SRC SRC --> ADF : Return all records deactivate SRC ADF -> SV : Validate schema (full) ADF -> DE : Deduplicate (full dataset) ADF -> BRZ : TRUNCATE + INSERT full snapshot\nto staging partition ADF -> WM : SET watermark to current MAX timestamp == PHASE 3 | Silver Layer — Cleansing & Conformation == ADF -> SLV_T : Trigger Silver transformation job activate SLV_T SLV_T -> BRZ : READ unprocessed Bronze records SLV_T -> SLV_T : Apply cleansing rules:\n- Null handling\n- Type standardization\n- String normalization SLV_T -> SLV_T : Apply business rules:\n- Insurance domain validations\n- Policy/claim range checks alt Validation passed SLV_T -> SCD : Apply SCD logic\n(Type 1: overwrite / Type 2: expire + insert) activate SCD SCD --> SLV_T : SCD processed records deactivate SCD SLV_T -> SLV : MERGE into Silver Delta\n(UPSERT by business key + effective_date) activate SLV SLV --> SLV_T : MERGE confirmed deactivate SLV ADF -> PL : INSERT Pipeline_Log\n(Step=SILVER_TRANSFORM, Status=SUCCESS) else Validation failed SLV_T -> PE : INSERT Pipeline_Error\n(Step=SILVER_VALIDATION, details) ADF -> AM : Emit error alert\n(threshold breach → SLA alert) end deactivate SLV_T == PHASE 4 | Gold Layer — Aggregation & KPI Build == ADF -> GLD_T : Trigger Gold aggregation job activate GLD_T GLD_T -> SLV : READ Silver conformed tables\n(incremental delta since last Gold run) GLD_T -> GLD_T : Compute aggregations:\n- Rolling window KPIs\n- Claims frequency/severity\n- Premium vs exposure ratios GLD_T -> DMB : Build/refresh Fact & Dimension tables activate DMB DMB --> GLD_T : Dimensions upserted, Facts merged deactivate DMB GLD_T -> GLD : MERGE into Gold Delta\n(Partition by report_date, region) activate GLD GLD --> GLD_T : MERGE confirmed deactivate GLD ADF -> PL : INSERT Pipeline_Log\n(Step=GOLD_BUILD, Status=SUCCESS) deactivate GLD_T == PHASE 5 | Serving Layer — Consumption == GLD -> SERVE : DirectQuery / Scheduled import\n(Schema contracts enforced) note right of SERVE : Power BI — Dashboards\nML Models — Feature extraction\nAPIs — Data products\nLakehouse — SQL analytics == PHASE 6 | Batch Close & Monitoring == ADF -> BL : UPDATE Batch_Log\n(Status=SUCCESS, End_Time=NOW(),\nTotal_Rows_Ingested, Total_Errors) ADF -> AM : Emit batch completion metrics\n(duration, row counts, error rate) AM -> AM : Evaluate SLA thresholds:\n- Batch duration > 4h → ALERT\n- Error rate > 5% → ALERT alt SLA breached AM --> SCH : Fire SLA alert (Email/Teams/PagerDuty) end deactivate ADF == PHASE 7 | Error Handling & Retry == ADF -> PE : Log error details\n(Batch_ID, Step, Error_Code, Message) ADF -> BL : UPDATE Batch_Log Status=FAILED ADF -> AM : Emit failure alert AM -> ADF : Trigger retry\n(Backoff: 1min → 5min → 15min | Max: 3) alt Retry succeeded ADF -> BL : UPDATE Batch_Log\n(Status=RECOVERED, Retry_Count=N) else Max retries exhausted AM --> SCH : CRITICAL ALERT — manual intervention note over ADF : Pipeline halted\nRollback: invalidate corrupted batch end @enduml","format":"svg"}
